description: React component for managing user access tokens in user security settings, including creating, revoking, enabling, disabling, and displaying tokens with confirmation modals.

classes.name: UserAccessTokenSection
classes.description: React component class for managing user access tokens in the user security settings interface.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when component props change, focusing edit button if needed.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes token data by clearing and fetching user access tokens.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with incoming props.

methods.name: startCreatingToken
methods.description: Sets state to start token creation process.

methods.name: handleCreateToken
methods.description: Creates a new user access token after validation.

methods.name: confirmCopyToken
methods.description: Shows confirmation modal to ensure token copy before proceeding.

methods.name: confirmCreateToken
methods.description: Prepares confirmation modal for creating a system admin token.

methods.name: saveTokenKeyPress
methods.description: Handles key press events for token creation input.

methods.name: confirmRevokeToken
methods.description: Shows confirmation modal before revoking a token.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI for managing user access tokens, including token list, creation, and confirmation modals.
